facts: About 940 people (2020), the second smallest of Guam's 19 villages
On the west coast, at the mouth of the Hagåtña River
worth_knowing: Called Agana until 1998, when the Guam Legislature restored the original Chamorro name. It is the westernmost territorial capital city of the United States.
